primary_findings: The iteration-3 raw/canonical split fixed the main probe-009 ambiguity. Exact-menu specimens used canonical_semantic_pointer = CREATE ui.menu@v1 while keeping canonical_object_class = ui.menu and object_version = v1.

All registry-gap, opaque-pointer, and ambiguous-abstain specimens preserved the boundary against pointer invention, nearest-class repair, obligation expansion, implementation authority, and family selection.

The remaining failures are shape discipline rather than semantic drift: one mini specimen shortened artifact_kind to candidate, two mini specimens drifted selection_status while preserving the safe route, and six specimens used a plausible but non-canonical competency claim status.

The prompt-only harness is now good enough to elicit the intended semantic route, but it is not strong enough to enforce closed subfield enums consistently without a validator or field injection layer.

model_notes.note: All four mini outputs stayed inside the declaration loop and preserved raw/canonical pointer boundaries. Mini still showed the most schema slippage: one artifact_kind shortening, two selection_status drifts, and competency claim status drift across all four.

All four GPT-5.4 outputs preserved route, pointer boundaries, and authority boundaries. The low-effort runs used non-canonical competency claim statuses, while the medium-effort runs were fully clean under this assessment.

recommended_next_iteration: Move fixed fields such as schema, artifact_kind, loop_state, and semantic_declaration_session_ref into harness-injected values rather than asking the resident model to restate them.
Represent resident_model_competency_claim_rows as a closed enum contract and validate claim_status mechanically.
Make selection_status case-specific and mechanically checked: registry-gap candidates remain candidate_only, opaque/no-pointer cases remain not_selected.
Add an automated score script for the specimens so future probes produce consistent parse, route, shape, and boundary metrics.
Use the next run to compare prompt-only generation against a wrapper that validates and remands malformed fields.
overall_assessment: Iteration 3 materially improved semantic-pointer fidelity and preserved the non-authority doctrine across all specimens. The next useful step is no longer another prompt wording tweak; it is a thin harness validator/injector that turns semantic route success into strict artifact validity.
